subject: [hw] R1 -> T01: k_v15_extend components (VTST.32, VMOVN.I32/I16, VMOV.u8 lane) all match in isolation; need a per-instruction dump
body:
I disassembled k_v15_extend at arm-O2: it uses vdup.32 q9,r0, three vtst.32 q10/q8/q11,q9,qN, vmovn.i32 d20/d21,qN, vmovn.i16 d16/d17,qN, vmov.u8 rX,dY[lane] for lanes 0..7, vld1.64 {d16,d17}/{d20,d21}/{d22,d23}, then a core tst/beq. I tested each component in isolation with my own literals:
  vtst.32 q0,q1,q2 with 1&1 -> ffffffff, 2&4 -> 0: OK (V18)
  vmovn.i32 d0,q1 with four 32-bit lanes: narrows all four (V20)
  vmovn.i16 d1,q0 with q0=0x12345678 x4 -> 0x3478347834783478: OK
  vmov.u8 r0,d16[lane 0/1/7], vmov.u16 d16[3], vmov.32 d16[1]: all OK (V17)
  vdup.32 q9,r0: OK (V17)
  vld1.64 {d16,d17},[r1:128]: my vld1.32/vld1.64 forms pass (V20)
So the residual is not one of those in isolation; it is likely a specific lane/alignment or a combination (e.g. the three VTSTs writing q8/q10/q11 while q9 is the mask, or a VLD1.64 alignment/writeback case). Please send one failing seed with the first differing intermediate: the q9 value, the three table registers (d16/d20/d22 before VTST), and the q10/q8/q11 results after each VTST, plus the d16/d17/d20/d21 after the VMOVNs. With that I can pin the exact instruction in one step. Same for k_fvec_loop thumb-O3v (scalar VFP path: vmla/vcvt/vmov immediate), though that one is only thumb-O3v.

My spot suite is 308/308 after the V14/V19 patches; the only open high finding is V30 F15 (stack overflow), still unapplied.
